about_the_game: "Godcall Defense Line" is a multiplayer cooperative game that integrates various elements such as action, strategy, real - time strategy, and tower defense. Players can summon various gods, ghosts, beasts, heroes, as well as defensive buildings like walls, guns, etc., to defend against the constantly incoming enemy forces. The summoned objects, except for buildings, can guard at any location or follow the player's actions. Maps, levels, and characters of various different styles will be added in the future. In terms of strategy, it is designed to allow players to deploy their team's defense line without having to consider numerical calculations as much as possible. If you're looking for a light - strategy game for two - player cooperative combat on the same device, this one is quite suitable. Initially, I wanted to find such a game but couldn't, so I came up with this idea. For two - player play, it also supports dual - monitors, which is much better than split - screen play on a single monitor. It supports both gamepad and full - keyboard operation, so that children who are not familiar with the keyboard can play with older friends.
